note: The main banks, chosen as the best-known large card issuers (no central bank ranking was read): TBC Bank, Bank of Georgia and Liberty Bank. TBC Bank's and Liberty Bank's credit card addresses answered not found, and Bank of Georgia's card page is built by script and showed no terms; none was read. Terabank's credit card page, read in full on 2026-10-30 (first read 2026-10-29 for its first tier alone), is written in full: its Credit Card (a limit of 500 to 850), Next Card (851 to 10,000) and Platinum Card (10,001 to 30,000), in lari, with their annual service fees (20, 30 and 85 lari; 15, 15 and 25 in dollars or euros, not written: a loan under a million lari is issued in lari unless the income is in the same currency), annual interest rates of 29%, 25% and 23%, a grace period of 55 days, a minimum monthly payment of 5% of the amount spent, and a cash withdrawal fee at Terabank's ATMs of 3% with a minimum of 9 lari (the Platinum 1% with a minimum of 15; other ATMs cost more and aren't written). The card itself costs nothing to issue. Paying in lari through international channels costs 1.5%, at most 10 lari, which isn't a foreign currency fee and isn't written.
